class1_rule: Class 1 (other than Division 1.4 compatibility group S) requires manual verification against the explosives loading provisions.
manual_checks: Toxic (6.1) and infectious substances (6.2) separation from foodstuffs, feed and live animals
Radioactive material (Class 7) separation distances and transport index limits
Self-reactive substances (4.1) and organic peroxides (5.2) protection from direct sunlight and heat
Cryogenic liquids and dry ice: ventilation and quantity limits per aircraft/compartment
Magnetized material positioning relative to aircraft compasses
Cargo Aircraft Only packages: accessibility requirements
